Check that a logical join key is all NA (#70)

Source: R/lower.R
check_unspecified_join_key.Rd

dplyr gives a logical key that is all NA (vctrs "unspecified") the type of the key it is joined to. Whether the column is one is a matter of its values, so it is checked when the join runs: all null with rows, or a vctrs::unspecified() column (cast$marker), passes; anything else has no common type and raises the incompatible-type error. apply_join_key_casts() checks the pairs in by order, each on its source column before any temp copy is made, so the first bad pair is the one named.

Usage

check_unspecified_join_key(ptr, idx, cast, by)
